SELECT organization_type_structure, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE organization_type_structure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did wind or hydro supply more of New York's power in 2023?

SELECT fuel_category, round(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / 12) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category IN ('Wind', 'Hydro') AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which counties in California have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US06%' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry patents were published in the United States in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE country = 'US' AND publication_date LIKE '2020%'
Which counties lost the most residents in 2024?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(npopchg2024 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many urologists are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'UROLOGY'
What fed and drained the Highway Trust Fund in fiscal 2024?

SELECT account_desc, max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc NOT LIKE 'Balance%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many organisations are listed as PubChem data sources?
What types of patent application are filed most, regular, provisional, reissue or reexamination?
SELECT application_type, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average Henry Hub spot price in 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(value AS double)), 2) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period LIKE '2023%'
Which plumbing and heating contractors earned the most from federal work on Long Island since 2020?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE naics_code = '238220' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND upper(primary_place_of_performance_county_name) IN ('NASSAU', 'SUFFOLK') AND action_date_fiscal_year >= '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NIH-funded projects were based at organizations in New York in fiscal year 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_state = 'NY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2022'
Which states had the most fatal crashes in work zones in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(wrk_zone AS integer) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many students were enrolled in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Which retired power plants were the largest?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT plant_name, state, round(sum(mw)) AS retired_mw FROM (SELECT plant_code, plant_name, state, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audit findings are material weaknesses?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_material_weakness AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_findings
Which companies hold the most chemistry patents in SureChEMBL?
SELECT substr(assignee, 3, length(assignee) - 4) AS assignee, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE assignee <> '[]' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people were on U.S. nonfarm payrolls in December 2024, in thousands?
SELECT value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES0000000001' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which tissues or body fluids are named most often as where ChEBI compounds were found?
SELECT component_text, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compound_origins WHERE component_text IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average hourly demand on New England's grid in 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(demand_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ISNE' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which organisations hold ownership stakes in the most Medicare hospitals?

SELECT organization_name_owner, count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_all_owners WHERE type_owner = 'O' AND organization_name_owner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many toxic-release reporting facilities are in Harris County, Texas?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _7_county = 'HARRIS' AND _8_st = 'TX'
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many regulatory reviews did OIRA complete in each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of Clean Water Act permit violations have drawn the most enforcement actions?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did PJM or MISO generate more electricity from coal in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_coal AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority IN ('PJM', 'MISO') AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people living in Queens were born outside the United States?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36081' AND variable = 'B05002_E013'
